en.headline: Po Pin Chau trail booked out on National Day
en.dek: AFCD Director Leung Kin-ming inspected the High Island booking scheme as the 2,000 daily cap filled for 1 and 2 October; the nearby Pak Lap Tsui section needs no reservation.
body: The Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geopark Trail was fully booked for National Day as the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department trial reservation scheme entered the Golden Week holiday.

Director Leung Kin-ming visited Sai Kung with legislators including New Territories East's Fong Kwok-shan. Between 9am and 5pm from 1 to 7 October, entry to the section requires a free named booking via Klook, with 2,000 places a day in four 500-person slots. The department has said 1 and 2 October were already full, and that unused booked slots may be released on site.

Lawmaker Fong said minibuses and taxis were busy this morning and expected fewer no-shows than over Mid-Autumn, when about half of those who reserved did not turn up. Banners at Pak Tam Chung remind visitors that a booking is required for Po Pin Chau during the controlled hours.

The department has pointed walkers without a slot to the 1.8-kilometre Pak Lap Tsui loop near East Dam, which needs no reservation and looks over Long Ke Wan, sea caves and hexagonal columns. The East Dam and Liu Ko Ngam sections of the same trail are also open without booking.

zh.headline: 國慶破邊洲段預約額滿 漁護署長到場視察
zh.dek: 黃金周試行預約制，10月1及2日全日2,000個名額已滿；未預約者可改走免預約的標尖角段。
body: 萬宜地質步道破邊洲段國慶日預約額滿，漁農自然護理署署長黎堅明到西貢視察黃金周試行預約安排。
黎堅明聯同新界東南立法會議員方國珊等人到場。10月1日至7日上午9時至下午5時進入該段須經Klook免費實名預約，每日2,000個名額、分四節每節500人。署方早前已公布1日及2日全日額滿，並會視乎情況釋放名額供即場預約。
方國珊表示，今早小巴及的士載客量高，估計連續七日假期「甩底」會較中秋少。中秋三日假期平均每日約一半預約者未有到場。北潭涌一帶有橫額提醒須預約才可進入破邊洲。
未能預約的市民可改走東壩附近長約1.8公里、約一個半小時的標尖角環回段，沿途可見浪茄灣、海蝕洞及六角形岩柱，無須預約。東壩段及標尖角段同樣免費開放。
